financials_interim.notes: Source: Maharaja Foods PLC interim FS for the 3 months ended 30 Jun 2026 (unaudited, signed 13 Aug 2026). Statement of Comprehensive Income doc p.2 (printed 'Page 01'), Statement of Financial Position doc p.3 (Page 02), Statement of Changes in Equity doc p.4 (Page 03), Statement of Cash Flows doc p.5 (Page 04), Notes doc p.6-7 (Page 05-06), Shareholder info doc p.8 (Page 07). MFPE amalgamated its wholly-owned subsidiary Maharaja Marketing (Pvt) Ltd into itself (comparative period ended 31 Mar 2025 restated per Note 7, doc p.6); there is no longer a Group/Company distinction, so this is a single-entity filing stored as one GROUP row (closest schema fit, first-ever financial_statements entry for MFPE). Figures are in whole Rupees (not '000) -- unit_scale='1'. Revenue 316,768,118 vs 165,947,412 PY (+91%), driven by new retail-outlet expansion: Note 9 (doc p.6) discloses a Rs112.5Mn rights issue (announced 17 Oct 2025) of which Rs47,500,000 (42.2% of proceeds) was earmarked for 'Establishing of SPAR-Maharaja SaveMor retail outlet', 100% utilized by 30 May 2026 -- consistent with the cover page's 'Retail Growth' branding and photos of new SPAR-Maharaja SaveMor stores. Cost of Sales rose 85% (244,347,748 vs 132,417,475), slightly slower than revenue, lifting gross margin from 20.2% to 22.9% -- Gross Profit +116% (72,420,371 vs 33,529,938). Administration Expenses spiked 320% (28,136,489 vs 6,695,821, a Rs21.44Mn increase) and Sales & Distribution Expenses +134% (5,285,628 vs 2,256,620), consistent with new-store operating-cost ramp-up (staff, rent, utilities for the new outlets) -- this compressed operating margin from 14.9% to 13.0% even though Profit from Operations grew 67% (41,200,383 vs 24,647,547) in absolute terms; this margin compression from store ramp-up costs is the single most important driver behind the gap between 91% revenue growth and a smaller 69% PAT increase. QA note: the printed 'Net Finance Cost' row on the income statement (p.2) has its 2026/2025 columns transposed relative to every other line on the page -- caught by cross-checking the PBT identity (Profit from Operations - Net Finance Cost = PBT): Finance Income (124,603) less Finance Expenses (7,171,901) = -7,047,298 for 2026 reproduces 41,200,383-7,047,298=34,153,085, matching the disclosed 2026 PBT exactly; the printed 'Net Finance Cost' 2026 figure of (4,587,157) is actually the 2025 value, and vice versa. Finance Income and Finance Expenses themselves are NOT swapped and were used directly for finance_costs/finance_income below (both independently reconcile against the PBT identity and against the Cash Flow statement's Interest Income/Interest Expenses adjustment lines, doc p.5). Profit Before Taxation 34,153,085 vs 20,060,389 PY (+70%); Taxation 9,976,116 vs 5,787,422 (+72%, effective rate 29.2% vs 28.8%, broadly stable); Net Profit 24,176,969 vs 14,272,967 (+69%). EPS: the income statement (p.2) shows EPS 0.18 (2026) / 0.10 (2025), but Note 5 (doc p.5) recalculates EPS using each period's actual weighted-average share count (137,500,000 for this quarter; 125,000,000 for the FY2025/26 Q1 comparative, i.e. before the Oct-2025 rights issue added 12,500,000 shares) and discloses 0.18 / 0.11 -- we use Note 5's weighted-average-share EPS (0.18, matching both presentations for the current period) since the income-statement comparative appears to apply the CURRENT 137,500,000 share count retroactively to the PY profit (14,272,967/137,500,000=0.1038 rounds to 0.10), which is not standard EPS practice -- flagged because this changes the prior-period EPS value used in the interim_updates yoy_json (0.11 per Note 5, not the 0.10 shown alongside the current-period income statement). Balance sheet (p.3, as at 30 Jun 2026 vs 31 Mar 2026 only -- no 30 Jun 2025 comparative BS is disclosed in this filing, so no true YoY balance-sheet comparison is possible, only QoQ against FY-end; this is noted as a gap). short_term_borrowings=275,020,686 combines Bank Borrowings-current (204,353,431) with Bank Balance Overdrawn (70,667,255); excludes Lease Liabilities-current (1,764,946), kept separate as a non-borrowing line. long_term_borrowings=165,002,791 (non-current Bank Borrowings only; excludes Deferred Tax Liability, Defined Benefit Obligation and non-current Lease Liabilities, none of which are borrowings). trade_receivables=305,852,846 and trade_payables=136,770,859 are the combined 'Trade and Other Receivables/Payables' lines (not split into pure-trade vs other) -- flagged as combined since MFPE does not disclose the split; the separate 'Amount Due from/to Related Party' line (66,573,633 receivable this period; nil payable, vs 15,631,581 payable at 31 Mar 2026) is excluded from both. cash_and_equivalents=28,984,027 is the gross Balance Sheet cash figure; the Cash Flow statement's period-end cash of (41,683,228) nets this against the 70,667,255 Bank Balance Overdrawn (28,984,027-70,667,255=-41,683,228, reconciles exactly). Cash flow (p.5): cash_from_operations=13,754,464 (net of Rs10,900,256 tax paid); capex=(16,060,362) (Purchase of PP&E); cash_from_investing=(15,935,759); cash_from_financing=63,394,909, driven by a fresh Rs75,000,000 'Loan Received' during the quarter -- the FY2025/26 rights-issue proceeds used to partially settle short-term loans/overdrafts (Rs50,000,000, 100% utilized by 2 Mar 2026) predate this quarter and are not a cash-flow item in this period. depreciation_amortization=4,372,828 (Depreciation only, per CF statement; no separate intangible amortization disclosed). No subsidiaries remain post-amalgamation, so minority_interest=0.
